claims.explanation: UNC0321 is a picomolar EHMT2/G9a inhibitor whose cellular selectivity is likely driven by dependence on G9a/GLP-mediated H3K9me2 and p53-K373 methylation, so lines with high EHMT2 expression and intact p53 signaling are most sensitive, while those with low EHMT2 or compensatory epigenetic programs are protected. The virtual-cell response (MYC/CCND1/FOSL1 down, stress/apoptosis genes up) is consistent with G9a inhibition disrupting proliferation and survival in responsive lineages.

features.basis: target dependence; G9a is overexpressed in cancers and its inhibition blocks growth
G9a dimethylates p53 K373 to inactivate it; p53-mutant lines may escape dependence on this axis
virtual cell shows CCND1 down after treatment, suggesting cyclin D1-driven lines depend on G9a for proliferation
virtual cell up MYCBP2 and MYC-associated stress response; MYC-driven lines may be more sensitive to epigenetic inhibition
virtual cell shows FOSL1 down, indicating AP-1-dependent lines may be selectively affected
virtual cell shows IGFBP3 down; high IGFBP3 may buffer against apoptosis
virtual cell shows BAG3 down; high BAG3 may protect from stress-induced death
UNC0321 inhibits Rab4 and Rab4 overexpression promotes survival/proliferation
GLP/EHMT1 is a co-target of quinazoline G9a inhibitors and contributes to H3K9me2
UNC0321 activates Akt/mTOR in endothelial cells; active Akt signaling may protect cancer lines
mTOR pathway activation promotes survival and may reduce sensitivity to G9a inhibition
virtual cell up SOX2; stem-like epigenetic dependencies may increase sensitivity
